messages:
maya: Heads-up — opened PR #4217 with a new 'seed-node bootstrap' section for private installs. Focus is semi-airgapped sites where ops can do a one-time outbound fetch for certs. Need doc review + a short systemd snippet and a curl fallback example. Preview link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4217 :link:

ci-bot: CI: build passed · docs lint OK · preview: https://deploy-preview.internal.redwood/4217 · (build 8839)

alex: reading now. quick ask: can we include a minimal curl fallback for sites that can’t run scp? e.g. `curl --retry 3 --fail --tlsv1.2 -o /tmp/seed.tgz https://example.com/seed.tgz` — some customers only allow outbound HTTP(s).

maya: good call. I'll add both `scp` and `curl` examples and a note that TLS 1.2+ is required. also adding a sentence about ephemeral cert TTL (30m) and how to extend for longer maintenance windows.

harper: on KMS/HSM side please call out that PKCS#11 socket path varies on appliances (eg `/var/run/pkcs11/socket` vs `/tmp/pkcs11.sock`). small line under "Key management" will help avoid confusion.

sam: minor: links in checklist 4.2 are 404 on the preview — the CA rotation anchor uses `#rotate-seed-ca` but the checklist links to `#rotating-seed-ca`. I'll push a tiny anchor fix unless you want it in the same PR, maya.

maya: thanks — I'll rebase and fold that in. also debating whether to include `--verify-sha256` in seed-sync example. is that overkill?

harper: include it. we should show the checksum example and a note about verifying on low-trust networks. also add a short troubleshooting tip: "if seed-sync exits with code 2, check MTU on the transit link (common in VPN appliances)." we've hit this with two customers.

alex: :thumbsup: Approve from docs side once checksum example is in. one more item: call out the env var `REDWOOD_SEED_MODE=seed-only` for installs that must not reach model-registry during bootstrap.

docs-bot: Docs reminder: label 'needs-legal' not set on PR #4217. Do we need an export-control / cert-bundling blurb?

maya: based on previous conversations, no formal legal text required, but i'll add a short note on secure handling of cert bundles and ping legal for a quick thumbs-up.

sam: pushed the anchor fix to your branch (maya) and also added a one-line link to the conn-checker CLI example.

maya: awesome — plan: update the PR today with curl fallback + checksum + harper's PKCS11 note, wait for CI preview to re-run, then alex can merge if no further changes. ETA EOD PT.

ci-bot: CI: preview updated: https://deploy-preview.internal.redwood/4217?update=2 · build 8842

alex: will merge after lunch if no blockers. thanks everyone! :coffee:
